title: A signet changes hands
text: Heraldry news: somewhere in the city, an old head has died and a new one lifts the signet. Every succession reshuffles who owes whom — including you.

effects.tpl: Black-edged letters and good wine. The new head receives you first among the new faces. +12 prestige.
You update your mental map of debts and grudges. Knowledge is leverage that never rots.
